BiblicalUsage: Pi-Beseth was a city of Egypt, named once in Ezekiel 30:17: the young men of Aven and of Pi-beseth shall fall by the sword, and these cities shall go into captivity. One verse is all Scripture gives it — a city named only in its judgment.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that a city known only for its fall is a warning, not a footnote.
